quotes.quote: Given the source code hashes of C/C++ libraries, this endpoint attempts to find the closest upstream library and version.
The list of libraries that can currently be identified are the C/C++ projects integrated into the OSS-Fuzz project.
This means that not all C/C++ packages are represented in our database.
The API will return a number of possible versions for your package, ranked by how well the version matched your local copy.
